input: Central Z2 pi-flux slice: u(x,0)=1, u(x,1)=(-1)^x0, u(x,2)=(-1)^(x0+x1), n even; every spatial plaquette holonomy is -1. Global conjugation is then an exact symmetry of the output law.

depth_0_n6_mean_abs_Cov_by_beta.reading: ordering onset between beta 2 and 3 at n=6

conclusion: For this input the covariance does not decay out to the antipode at any tested depth, so C must grow like n^4 and the distant sum grows with volume. A pointwise all-input C appears unavailable, and all-input farCost control appears false. The theorems remain true as implications but look unusable with volume-uniform constants.
not_shown: No rigorous long-range-order proof; sizes are n<=12 at j=0 and n<=8 at j>=1.
Depth j=8 and the j-to-infinity ground were not run with the corrected code.
energy(Pf)<=C*loss(f) itself is not refuted, since it is an integrated statement and this input is exponentially suppressed.
Typical inputs and the defect threshold for ordering were not studied.
Only the flat control and this one input were tested.
code_note: A first version had wrong inverses in temporal couplings, giving false no-ordering at j>=1. Those runs are discarded. The j=0 path never used those terms; its numbers came from the earlier build and were not rerun on the corrected file.
route_consequence: The distant-sum target should be restated for a weighted or eligible set of inputs under the true law, with the exceptional set paid for by its probability. The all-twelve Clay status is unchanged.
